args.question: What should the body of the maintenance notice be?

args.subject: Maintenance Notice
args.body:
Dear Vendors,

This is a maintenance notice to inform you of scheduled system updates and outages. The maintenance will take place on Friday, October 20th, from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. During this time, access to our platform may be temporarily unavailable.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

Best regards,
Halden Logistics Team
